question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in the bracket to fill in the blank.

Rohan ________ (insufficient) the compassion required to be a doctor.
solution:
The correct answer is "**lacked**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence implies that Rohan did not have the necessary compassion to become a doctor.
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Insufficient" means not enough.** (अपर्याप्त, नाकाफ़ी)
 
 
• Example: The students got insufficient time for the test.
 
 
 
• **"Lacked" means to have none or not enough of something.** (कमी रह गई थी)
 
 
• Example: He lacked the spirit of being a winner.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the synonym of "insufficient" is "lacked".

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Oversized" means too large in size, which is not relevant in the context of the sentence.(वृहदाकार)
 
• "Was deprived" means to be denied something, which does not fit the context of the sentence.(वंचित था)
 
• "Voided" means to cancel or invalidate, which is not relevant in the context of the sentence.(अमान्य कर)
